private_data_rule: This spec contains no private bug memory. Private bug records and predictions must live in Apple Notes/private storage only.
plain_rule: Predictions are not truth yet. They are questions saved for controlled testing.
plain_brain_image: A prediction is a seed. A test is where we see if the seed grows. Until then, we do not call it a tree.
purpose: Combine known bugs in a safe private lab to predict possible compound bugs, explain them simply, save them to the Prediction Ledger, and build controlled test plans.
hard_rules: Do not create real bugs in the live app.
Do not test predictions on the live good app first.
Do not change latest pointer during prediction tests.
Do not expose private Bug Memory in normal Control Room.
Do not upload private Bug Memory or predictions to public GitHub.
Do not call a prediction confirmed until controlled testing supports it.
Do not use wrapper patching as a final fix for core app behavior.

private_window_role.meaning: The private window is the private command room, not the permanent storage box.
can_show_temporarily: Prediction Ledger view loaded from Notes
must_clear_or_not_keep_publicly: private server or Notes bridge internals
private_window_role.permanent_storage_target: Apple Notes through the Notes Backend Bridge

rooms.name: Bug Catalog
rooms.role: Known bugs, easy names, fundamental ranking, Plain Brain explanations.
rooms.source: Loaded from Apple Notes/private bug memory ZIP, not stored in public app.

rooms.name: Bug Mixer
rooms.role: Pick Bug A and Bug B, then predict the possible third failure.

rooms.name: Prediction Ledger
rooms.role: Save predictions as untested records so they can be tested later.

rooms.name: Controlled Test Lab
rooms.role: Build safe test plans and record test results without damaging the live app.

bug_easy_name_rule.good_name: Name explains what the bug does.

examples.meaning: The app gets split between two version truths.
A newer layer fights an older layer underneath.
Saved themes point to the newest colors instead of their own frozen copy.
Private Bug Memory does not have a clean private home.
The status box changes too much while the slider moves.

combination_law.question: If Bug A and Bug B happen together, what third failure could appear?

prediction_record_schema.status: untested | testing_planned | sandbox_tested | confirmed | partly_confirmed | weakened | rejected | still_unknown
prediction_record_schema.possible_bug_name: easy name for predicted compound bug

test_safety_gates: Name exactly what is being tested.
Use a disposable test copy first.
Confirm last_good before any risky test.

controlled_test_plan_schema.stage: theory_only | fake_state_test | local_sandbox_copy | disposable_test_file | safe_writer_guarded_test | current_app_guarded_test
controlled_test_plan_schema.goal: what the test tries to learn

notes_backend_outputs.plain_brain_prompt: human readable explanation saved to Notes

notes_backend_outputs.test_plan: controlled test plan saved with prediction

features: save prediction chunk to Notes through Shortcut

next_after_spec: Build private-bug-mixer-lab-v1.html as a separate private tool. Do not alter the main app visual layout yet.
